scripts.lint: node scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.js && pnpm arch:config:check && pnpm arch:check && pnpm lint:root && nx run-many -t lint && oxlint . --deny-warnings
scripts.arch:config:check: pnpm arch:config:generate && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- 'v2/identity/safer-architecture.config.json' 'v2/router/safer-architecture.config.json')" && git diff --exit-code -- 'packages/*/safer-architecture.config.json' 'v2/identity/safer-architecture.config.json' 'v2/router/safer-architecture.config.json'
scripts.typecheck: nx run-many -t build && nx run-many -t typecheck
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm --filter @moltzap/protocol docs:generate && pnpm --filter @moltzap/client docs:generate && pnpm --filter @moltzap/server-core exec tsx ../../scripts/generate-constants-snippets.ts
scripts.docs:check:drift: pnpm docs:generate && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- 'docs/modules/v2/**' 'v2/identity/src/MODULE.md' 'v2/identity/src/**/MODULE.md' 'v2/router/src/MODULE.md' 'v2/router/src/**/MODULE.md')" && git diff --exit-code docs/ 'packages/**/MODULE.md' 'v2/identity/src/MODULE.md' 'v2/identity/src/**/MODULE.md' 'v2/router/src/MODULE.md' 'v2/router/src/**/MODULE.md' README.md && pnpm docs:check:no-hardcoded-constants && pnpm docs:check:doc-imports-resolve
scripts.docs:check:mermaid: puppeteer browsers install chrome-headless-shell && pnpm --filter @moltzap/protocol exec tsx scripts/check-mermaid.ts
scripts.simulator:example:check: pnpm nx build @moltzap/simulator && pnpm exec tsc -p examples/simulator/tsconfig.json
